title: Sharing and collaboration
subtitle: This device, the people, the invitations and the documents you share.
signedOut: Sign in to share a document.

device.title: This device
device.subtitle: Its public key identifies you to your collaborators. The private key never leaves this machine.

friends.title: People
friends.subtitle: Add by Discord username or NetsuRush handle. You can only share with someone on this list.

status.unknown: Nobody matches. Check the username, or paste their Discord ID.
status.ambiguous: Several people match. Use their Discord ID.

projects.title: Shared documents
projects.subtitle: The documents shared with your account. The ones on this machine open from their own module.

activity.title: Collaboration activity
activity.changed_one: {{count}} person changed a document while you were away. Open it to retrieve the changes.
activity.changed_other: {{count}} people changed a document while you were away. Open it to retrieve the changes.
activity.media_one: {{count}} person is waiting for original media. Open the document and stay online to transfer it.
activity.media_other: {{count}} people are waiting for original media. Open the document and stay online to transfer it.
activity.key_one: {{count}} new member is waiting for secure access. Open the document to deliver the project key.
activity.key_other: {{count}} new members are waiting for secure access. Open the document to deliver the project key.

notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this installation.

dialog.title: Collaborate
dialog.subtitle: Pick the people to invite to this document.
dialog.noFriends: Add someone first in Settings › Account › Sharing.
dialog.notice: The document becomes collaborative. Invited people receive the invitation on their next start.
dialog.mediaMissing_one: {{count}} media file missing from disk: {{names}}. Find it (moved folder?), then share again.
dialog.mediaMissing_other: {{count}} media files missing from disk: {{names}}. Find them (moved folder?), then share again.

rotationPending: The revocation is recorded. New publications wait for an owner device to finish key rotation.

staleHead.title: Stale recovery branch
staleHead.warning: A device has not merged this branch for more than 30 days.
staleHead.confirmWarning: Changes published only by this device will be lost permanently. Continue only if that device can no longer reconnect.

lifecycle.leaveWarning: You keep what this device already received, but can no longer sync this project.
lifecycle.deleteWarning: Rendezvous data, invitations and encrypted recovery copies will be deleted for every member. This cannot be undone.

sync.queued: Changes are waiting here. They'll be sent automatically as soon as a device is reachable.

panel.title: Sharing status
panel.rotation: A new key is needed. The owner has to open the app.
panel.nobodyReachable: Nobody online. Nothing has been sent.
panel.waitingKey_one: {{count}} waiting for the key. Stay online.
panel.waitingKey_other: {{count}} waiting for the key. Stay online.

board.noScene: Save this board to the scene library first.
board.willAdopt: This board will be copied into the scene library. The .netsu file stays on your disk.

error.authorization: Access to this shared document was refused. Sign in again, or ask the owner to invite you again.
error.conflict: Another change went through at the same time. Try again in a moment.
error.corrupt: Some shared data that arrived is damaged. If this happens again, send a bug report.
error.keyPending: This document's key hasn't reached this device yet. Stay online: it arrives when another member opens the document.
error.network: Can't reach the sharing server. Check your connection, then try again.
error.readOnly: This document is shared with you as read-only.
error.storage: Can't read or write sharing data on this disk. Check free space, then try again.
error.unavailable: Sharing isn't available right now. Sign in again, then reopen the document.
error.validation: Sharing couldn't process this request. If this happens again, send a bug report.
error.server: The sharing server refused the operation. Try again; if this happens again, send a bug report.
error.collectionMissing: This collection no longer exists on this machine.
error.collectionChanged: The collection changed while its media were being prepared. Try again.
error.collectionSave: Can't save sharing for this collection. Try again.
error.collectionMedia: Can't prepare this collection's media for sharing.
error.archiveFolder: This collection has no archive folder. Choose one, then share again.
error.notebookMissing: This notebook or page no longer exists on this machine.
error.notebookBound: This notebook already contains a shared document.
error.notebookSave: Can't save sharing for this notebook. Try again.
error.mediaNotShared_one: {{count}} media item isn't shared because its file can't be read: {{names}}. Find it (moved folder?).
error.mediaNotShared_other: {{count}} media items aren't shared because their files can't be read: {{names}}. Find them (moved folder?).
